QuestInfo.name: Starting Your Training
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart has some suggestions for you for starting your new life. Talk to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart suggested that you receive training to become a member of the knights. Kiku can get you started. \nGo see Training Instructor #b#eKiku#k#n at #b#m130010000##k.\r\n#r#eTip.#n Press the [W] key to open the World Map and locate the NPC.
QuestInfo.2: You accepted Neinheart's suggestion and started training to become a member of the knights. You can continue getting training from Training Instructor Kiku.

0.0: Enjoying your new life here in Ereve, Mihile? You'll get used to that name soon.\nHere in Ereve, everyone has devoted their lives to fight for Cygnus.
0.1: Why don't you join us? You can train and become a knight. It could be an opportunity to discover a new you.\r\n

yes.0: Oh, I assure you that it will be... quite the experience. Go register to be a trainee knight. #b#eKiku#k#n the Training Instructor will be expecting you on the double. Find Kiku at #b#m130010000##k.
yes.1: Before you go, I must tell you that #bKiku#k is not human. He's of the Piyo Tribe. Try to refrain from attacking him, will you? He's sent a number of overexcited troops to the medics already.

no.0: Why do you look as if I've just eaten your favorite cat? You're not shy about meeting new people, are you?

1.0:
You must be Mihile. Neinheart said you were coming over. Here's your paperwork.
#L0##bUh, yeah. I'm ready to learn.
  (It SPEAKS like a human...)#l
#k
1.1: Another bumpkin shocked to see a Piyo, huh? Well get your looks in now, cadet. \nYou aren't going to have time to gawk once the training starts.

npc.0: Kiku is in #bTraining Forest 1#k. Take a left and you will run into him. Or you could use your World Map with [W] if you're impatient.
